# Waypoint Integration API Reference

> **Assembly:** `LocalExile.Client.Waypoint` · **Public types:** `40`
>
> Dual-side `mod.json` manifest models (`DualModManifest`, `NativeClientManifest`), package & `.ui` validation (`DualModPackageValidator`, `UiLayoutLinter`), stored-block `NMB1` bundling (`ModBundlePacker`), SemVer ranges, PE patcher bridge, and installer/extender management (`WaypointModInstaller`, `WaypointExtenderManager`).

| `public static readonly IReadOnlySet<string> ClosedRegistryTables = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)` | Tables bound to compiled enums or fixed-size structures in 3.29 that cannot safely accept appended rows (`ItemClasses` compiled 103-entry enum; `Stats` fixed 23,362 / 0x5b42 rows where 0x5b43 is compiled `StatId::INVALID` across 35+ sites and 4 fixed-size tables OOB on `statId >= 0x5b43`). |

Two mods appending distinct entry keys to the SAME `.datc64` table produce ZERO conflicts; conflicts are reported only for duplicate `(table, entryKey)` keys, colliding explicit `allocateDeadStat.preferredSlot` assignments, or exceeding the 30-slot dead-stat pool. |
| `public static bool IsModNamespacedPath(string virtualPath, string modId)` | Returns true if a virtual path is properly namespaced under a `Mods/<segment>/` path matching the mod id (or its final hyphen-separated component, e.g. `harvest-garden` -> `Mods/Garden/` or `Mods/harvest-garden/`). |

**Kind:** `class` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.Waypoint` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.Waypoint/ModBundlePacker.cs`

Packs a mod's `client/` payload directory into a deterministic `<id>-<hash>.bundle.bin` using Oodle-compatible uncompressed stored blocks (`0xCC 0x06` per 0x40000-byte chunk, as verified in `10-verification.md` §2) plus a companion `manifest.json` with SHA-256 verification.

|---|---|
| `public static byte[] EncodeClientText(string text)` | Encodes a UTF-8 or UTF-16 text file to Path of Exile 3.29's expected BOM text format: UTF-16LE with BOM (`FF FE`) and CRLF line endings (matching `spikes/encode-overlay.py`). |
| `public static byte[] EncodeClientTextNoBom(string text)` | Encodes a UTF-8 or UTF-16 text file to Path of Exile 3.29's BOM-less text format (`.sm`, `.mat`, `.amd`): UTF-16LE without BOM and CRLF line endings. |

### `WaypointModInstaller`

**Kind:** `class` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.Waypoint` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.Waypoint/WaypointModInstaller.cs`

Installs, upgrades, audits, and cleanly uninstalls dual-side mods into a LocalExile checkout's `Mods/Binaries/<id>/` and `Mods/Client/<id>/` directories. Never touches stock client files (`Client/Game.exe`, `Client/Content.ggpk`, `Client/Bundles2/`).
